messages:
alina: Heads-up — Solara POC hitting slow initial responses + bursts of 429s during a ramp. They peak ~200 r/s. Customer is on hosted trial and asks for a quick fix + answers for legal/infosec (KMS + egress). Can we swarm?

ben: Copy. Can you drop sample request_ids + the time window? Need logs to see if it's throttling, queueing, or model-side stalls.

maria: Pasted relevant snippets from the timeframe (15:02:10–15:04:00 UTC):
```
[2026-03-20T15:02:12Z] request_id=abc123 status=429 route=/v1/generate reason=rate_limit shard=shard-7 queue_len=143
[2026-03-20T15:02:13Z] request_id=abc124 first_token_latency=580ms tokens=1 model=gptx-3-8b kv_cache_hit=false
[2026-03-20T15:02:14Z] request_id=abc126 status=200 first_token_latency=1150ms tokens=1 model=gptx-3-8b kv_cache_hit=false
[2026-03-20T15:02:20Z] autoscale:event=start target=shard-7 add=2 gpus
```

raj: Those lines look like queueing on shard-7 plus a KV cache miss storm. Their prompts are short (few tokens) so the batching window is probably accumulating requests and causing long TTFT. Current batch_window=50ms and max_batch_size=64 — with many short prompts that increases tail latency. Also kv_cache_hit=false spike suggests clients haven't warmed prefix cache or are sending unique prefixes.

ben: Good call. Short-lived prompts + large window = poor utilization for their workload. Quick fixes: reduce batch_window to 8–12ms, lower max_batch_size to 16 for that route, enable prefix caching/prefetch, and temporarily mark Solara as priority so they don't hit soft throttle.

alina: What are the operational risks if we change those in prod for just the Solara route?

raj: Low risk if scoped to their customer_id route. Autoscale already added GPUs (ops-bot recorded event). We'll monitor queue depth. If we reduce batch window we may increase per-token cost slightly but reduces TTFT a lot.

tim: From pricing side: if they move to a Dedicated trial we can guarantee X qps and fixed cost for the week. For hosted, explain tradeoffs: smaller batch windows -> higher effective unit cost. I can draft an estimate after QA confirms perf.

zoe: Also note: Solara's security team asked for KMS integration details and egress logging sample. I'll take the security questionnaire — please send me the SOC2/evidence snippets and we can authorize limited egress log sharing.

ops-bot: autoscaler: shard-7 scaled up by 2 GPU(s) at 2026-03-20T15:02:20Z (event id: as-9876). current_shard_count=5 -> 7.

raj: I've pushed a route override: batch_window=10ms, max_batch_size=16, kv_prefetch=enabled, priority=high for customer_id=solara-612. Rolling it now; payload version v2026-03-20-10.

maria: Running a synthetic repro against the overridden route now (15:06 UTC) — sending load generator script and current graphs to the dashboard.

maria: Quick results: after the override + autoscale, first-token latency for the test load dropped median 580ms -> 120ms, p95 from 1.1s -> 280ms, and 429s stopped. KV hit rate improved from ~12% -> ~68% after enabling prefetch. Link: https://console.redwood.example/d/solara-poc/metrics (customer-only link)

alina: Awesome. Solara legal also wants evidence of throttling behavior and per-tenant isolation before final approval. Zoe + Raj, can you assemble a short packet (logs + config diffs + autoscale events) we can hand to them?

zoe: Yep — I'll redact any internal ids and attach the KMS section. Raj, send the route override diff and the autoscale event ids.

raj: Sending the diffs now: route override (JSON) + autoscale event ids (as-9876).

tim: I'll prepare a Dedicated trial quote and options (1-week trial with a 20% trial discount). Will DM the numbers.

alina: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Solara and confirm they can run acceptance tests tomorrow morning. If anything regresses we'll reopen the swarm.

ben: One follow-up: recommend we add a per-route default template for short-prompt workloads to avoid this recurring (batch_window small, prefetch enabled). Filing a tiny infra task after postmortem.

alina: Filing the task and tagging eng-runtime. Closing the immediate swarm — will update if Solara reports anything else.
